capabilities: Build Mermaid diagrams visually with drag-and-drop or keyboard alternatives
Edit diagrams in place, in a pop-up, or as source code
Render mermaid blocks throughout the vault with the bundled Pele renderer
Add accessible titles and descriptions for screen readers
Customise colour themes, text size and Gantt chart public holidays
extras: Bundles the Pele renderer and the date-holidays library; Pele replaces Obsidian's own mermaid rendering for all blocks unless disabled in settings. Diagrams using features the visual editor does not cover open in Code mode so nothing is lost.
intentEvidence: Diagrams in your notes are drawn by the bundled Pele too, so they match the editor preview.
problem: Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian must be written as text, with no visual editing and no accessibility metadata for screen-reader users.

relations.evidence: A visual editor for Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian, with a live preview rendered by Pele.

summary: Visual drag-and-drop editor for Mermaid diagrams with live preview, accessible titles and descriptions, saved as ordinary mermaid code blocks.
